title: Combined cortical thickness and blink reflex recovery cycle to differentiate essential tremor with and without resting tremor
summary: Combining cortical-thickness MRI and blink-reflex recovery measurements with machine learning differentiated essential-tremor patients with and without resting tremor. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
